summary: Gate folders .vloop/state/gates/<id>/ now exist: the plan fence may write them, acceptance refuses a stray folder and stamps each task's fixtures, the plan hash and the post-session restore cover them, a resume with a changed folder is refused, and vloop task verify takes an optional command and records folder changes in gate_history.
verified: vloop task gate T5 exited 0 and printed GATE OK.
notes: state.PlanDigest(plan, gateFiles) is the session plan hash: with no gate files it equals the SHA-256 of state.json, so the hash only changes shape when folders exist. state.ReplaceGate is replaced by state.RecordGate(root, p, id, verify, reason, at); same-command with unchanged folder is now 'nothing to record'. A gate folder with no regular files digests to "" (empty dirs are not tracked by git). state.StampFixtures/FixturesMismatch and driver.CheckFixtures (called in Planner.Plan resume branch and Iterator.Run) do the stamp and the resume refusal. A new plan or a rejected plan removes .vloop/state/gates. docs/guide/commands.md was regenerated with go generate. No TestRun33GateRewrite exists any more (deleted in T4); the folder restore is covered by TestStateGuardGateFolders and the gate's e2e. go test of internal/cli fails inside a vloop session on TestTaskGate* unless VLOOP_* env is unset.
